capabilities.pipelineBody: Results are stored, so search, tagging and albums are instant — photos are never re-processed each time you search.
capabilities.pipelineHeadline: Three vision models, run once at upload.

desc.semanticSearch: Type "two dogs on the beach": the query is split into objects, counts and context, then scored by CLIP + tags + YOLO together.
desc.objectDetection: Detects 80 object classes in every photo with boxes and confidence — it can count how many people or cars there are.
desc.visualSimilarity: Open a photo and instantly see look-alikes: same angle, same scene, same subject.
desc.autoClassification: 17 tags such as Portrait, Food, Beach, Night… each with its own confidence and threshold, shown in AI Studio.
desc.smartAlbums: Save a search or a set of tags as an album — new matching photos appear automatically.
desc.sharing: Send photos device-to-device, invite friends into shared albums or create links that expire.

closing.statement: Stop scrolling through thousands of photos. Describe the moment — your library will find it.
closing.note: Nothing to install · Runs in your browser

footer.tagline: A photo library that understands every picture — search, classify and share your moments.
